# Fw Chat — Native Rust AI & MCP Workspace

> Zero-dependency pure-Rust chat and coding agent server (`fw`) with OpenAI Chat Completions, MCP, ACP, A2A, and WebGPU compute.

## Endpoints
- `https://fw.aphrody.com/` — Web app: chat, MCP tools, models and runtime status (Material 3)
- `https://fw.aphrody.com/webgpu` — WebGPU WGSL + Wasm32 harness
- `https://fw.aphrody.com/v1/chat/completions` — OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API
- `https://fw.aphrody.com/mcp` — In-process JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP endpoint
- `https://fw.aphrody.com/acp` — Agent Client Protocol JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint
- `https://fw.aphrody.com/openapi.json` — OpenAPI 3.1 specification
